records.rationale: In updateEvent, the new fallback is `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId` — when `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the only case this branch runs, since the ternary checks `externalCalendarId ?` first), the find compares against undefined and yields undefined, so `calendarId` becomes undefined instead of falling back to the destination calendar's externalId as the old code (`event.destinationCalendar?.externalId`) did. The deleteEvent fallback at line ~315 has the same self-referential dead lookup, making the fallback a no-op.
